title: LLM-Rosetta Provider Shim
description: Schema for provider.yaml shim configuration files.

logo.description: URL to the provider's logo image (SVG preferred).

response_id_prefix.description: Provider-specific prefix for response IDs (e.g. 'chatcmpl-', 'msg_', 'resp_'). Empty string means passthrough.

hoist_system_messages.description: Whether to hoist late system messages for prompt cache prefix stability.

api_key_env.description: Environment variable name for the API key (e.g. 'OPENAI_API_KEY').

models_path.description: Path or full URL for the upstream model list endpoint. Relative paths are appended to base_url.

model_id_field.description: JSON field name to use as model identifier when fetching the upstream model list. Defaults to 'id'.

custom_tools.description: Whether the provider natively accepts custom tool definitions ({type: 'custom'}). When false, custom tools are downgraded to function wrappers.

max_description_length.description: Maximum length for tool description strings. Longer descriptions are truncated.

search_mode.description: 'disabled' drops tool_search items. 'native' passes through. 'bridge' emulates via BM25 search.

multimodal_result.description: Whether the provider supports multimodal content in tool results natively. null defers to the converter default.

thinking_modes.description: Maps IR mode (auto/enabled/disabled) to provider thinking type value.

thinking_default.description: Default IR mode when the request has no explicit mode.

effort_field.description: Provider-side field path for the effort value (e.g. 'reasoning_effort', 'output_config.effort'). 'none' means provider does not accept effort.

effort_range.description: Supported IR effort range [floor, ceiling]. Values: minimal, low, medium, high, xhigh, max.

budget_ratio.description: Derive budget_tokens as max(1024, int(max_tokens * ratio)).

visibility_modes.description: Maps IR summary value to provider visibility value.

unsigned_blocks.description: How to handle unsigned reasoning blocks in responses.

model_overrides.description: Per-model reasoning overrides keyed by upstream model ID. Each entry inherits from the provider-level reasoning config.
